tools.name: close_whoami
tools.description: Show the Close user and organization this API key belongs to. Good first call to confirm the connection. Close API: GET /me/.

tools.name: close_list_users
tools.description: List the users (sales reps and admins) in the organization. Use their ids as assigned_to. Close API: GET /user/.

tools.name: close_list_lead_statuses
tools.description: List the lead statuses of the organization, in order. Use their ids as status_id. Close API: GET /status/lead/.

tools.name: close_list_opportunity_statuses
tools.description: List the opportunity statuses (pipeline stages) of the organization. Close API: GET /status/opportunity/.

tools.name: close_list_pipelines
tools.description: List the opportunity pipelines and the statuses in each. Close API: GET /pipeline/.

tools.name: close_list_leads
tools.description: List leads (companies or accounts) in the organization, one page at a time. Use close_search_leads to find a lead by name. Close API: GET /lead/.

tools.name: close_get_lead
tools.description: Fetch one lead with its name, status, addresses and custom fields. Close API: GET /lead/{id}/.

tools.name: close_search_leads
tools.description: Find leads whose name contains every word in the text (full words). Uses Close's Advanced Filtering. Close API: POST /data/search/.

tools.name: close_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (people), optionally only those on one lead. Close API: GET /contact/.

tools.name: close_list_opportunities
tools.description: List opportunities (deals), optionally filtered by lead or status. Close API: GET /opportunity/.

tools.name: close_list_activities
tools.description: List the activity timeline of one lead: notes, calls, emails, status changes. Close API: GET /activity/ with lead_id.

tools.name: close_list_tasks
tools.description: List lead tasks (action items with a due date), optionally filtered by lead, assignee or completion. Close API: GET /task/.

tools.name: close_create_lead
tools.description: Create a lead (a company or account). Close API: POST /lead/. Creates a record; no delete tool exists.

tools.name: close_update_lead
tools.description: Change the name, website, description or status of a lead. Only the fields you pass change. Close API: PUT /lead/{id}/.

tools.name: close_create_contact
tools.description: Add a contact (a person) to a lead. Close API: POST /contact/.

tools.name: close_create_note
tools.description: Add a plain-text note to a lead's activity timeline. Close API: POST /activity/note/.

tools.name: close_create_task
tools.description: Create a follow-up task on a lead with an optional due date and assignee. Close may email the assignee. Close API: POST /task/.

tools.name: close_update_task
tools.description: Mark a task complete or open again, or change its assignee. Close API: PUT /task/{id}/.

tools.name: close_create_opportunity
tools.description: Create a deal (opportunity) on a lead, with an optional value in cents, status and win likelihood. Close API: POST /opportunity/.

tools.name: close_update_opportunity
tools.description: Move an opportunity to another status, or change its value, likelihood or note. Only the fields you pass change. Close API: PUT /opportunity/{id}/.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: close_search_leads, close_list_activities · Private data: close_whoami, close_list_contacts, close_create_lead, close_create_contact · Public sink: close_search_leads, close_create_lead, close_create_contact, close_create_note, close_create_task, close_create_opportunity · Destructive: close_create_lead.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: close_search_leads, close_list_activities · Private data: close_whoami, close_list_contacts, close_create_lead, close_create_contact · Public sink: close_search_leads, close_create_lead, close_create_contact, close_create_note, close_create_task, close_create_opportunity · Destructive: close_create_lead

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
